description: FMCSA carriers flagged in one or more SMS BASIC safety categories (over the federal intervention threshold): Unsafe Driving, Hours-of-Service Compliance, Driver Fitness, Controlled Substances/Alcohol, Vehicle Maintenance. Returns carrier name, location, fleet size, which BASICs are flagged, and out-of-service inspection counts. ~1,526 carriers currently flagged. Filter by state, a specific BASIC, or minimum alert count.
